examples.description: Re-frame a scene for vertical video, focused left of centre

description: Re-frame one scene for a different aspect ratio. method 'analytic' re-centers and scales the EXISTING footage on a focus point (cheap, no new pixels, needs the source dimensions); method 'generative' outpaints new edges [$0.10/sec at provider cost].

focus_x.description: Focus point across the frame, 0-1 (analytic only).

focus_y.description: Focus point down the frame, 0-1 (analytic only).

method.description: analytic = crop/scale existing footage; generative = outpaint new edges.

project_id.description: The studio project (vp_…) this tool acts on.

prompt.description: What the new edges should contain (generative only).

name: studio.reframe_scene
